protocol.x: median over the type's flows of the mean distance to the k nearest normal KDDTrain+ flows
protocol.y: same, to the k nearest KDDTrain+ flows of the other attack types (the type itself excluded)
protocol.groups: held_out: KDDTrain+ types with >= 20 rows (recall from leave_one_out.json, test false-alarm rate about 5% because test normals come from the same file); unseen_test: KDDTest+ types absent from KDDTrain+ (query rows from KDDTest+, recall from the benchmark JSONs at the 5% validation target, where the test false-alarm rate drifts: RF 12.6%, IF normal-only 2.2%)
protocol.scaler: fit on all KDDTrain+ rows; the drop space is the 38 numeric columns, onehot adds the 3 categorical columns as one-hot
protocol.analysis_only: grouping KDDTest+ rows by type is for this analysis only; no model sees the test labels
protocol.pre_registered: x vs if_normal recall and y vs rf recall; the other pairs are reported for contrast
